summary: Parse, decode, and expand written knitting patterns. Translates abbreviations, calculates yarn requirements from gauge, tracks stitch counts across rows, and generates row-by-row instructions from condensed pattern notation. Use when a knitter needs help understanding, planning, or tracking a knitting project.
